title: Pod Salt Fusion Lemon Cake Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: As indulgent and comforting as dessert vapes get, Vaper’s Oven perfectly captures the warm, sweet aroma of freshly-baked fluffy sponge cake drizzled with sharp lemon icing. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
